Struct BitrateControl

Namespace
FFmpeg.Codecs.Video.LibSVTAV1
Assembly
FFmpeg.dll

Represents the bitrate control settings for the SVT-AV1 encoder. Provides configuration options for different bitrate control modes and adaptive quantization.

public struct BitrateControl : IEquatable<BitrateControl>

Bitrate

Gets or sets the target bitrate in bits per second (bps). Applicable for VBR and CBR modes.

public long? Bitrate { readonly get; set; }

Property Value

long?

CRF

Gets or sets the Constant Rate Factor (CRF) value. Configures the rate control to CRF mode with adaptive quantization set to DeltaQPredEfficiency. Valid range is 1-63.

[DisallowNull]
public int? CRF { readonly get; set; }

Property Value

int?

MaxBitrate

Gets or sets the maximum bitrate in bits per second (bps). Applies only to CRF mode. Accepts suffixes: b, k, and m.

public long? MaxBitrate { readonly get; set; }

Property Value

long?

MaxQP

Gets or sets the maximum quantizer value. Valid range is 1-63 and is only applicable for VBR and CBR modes. Default is 63.

public int? MaxQP { readonly get; set; }

Property Value

int?

MinQP

Gets or sets the minimum quantizer value. Valid range is 1-63, with the maximum value being MaxQP - 1. Only applicable for VBR and CBR modes. Default is 1.

public int? MinQP { readonly get; set; }

Property Value

int?

Mode

Gets or sets the rate control mode. Determines the mode used for bitrate control, such as CRF, VBR, or CBR.

public BitrateControl.BitrateControlMode? Mode { readonly get; set; }

BitrateControl.BitrateControlMode?

QP

Gets or sets the initial quantization parameter (QP) value. Applicable for CRF and CQP modes.

public int? QP { readonly get; set; }

Property Value

int?

VBRBiasPct

Gets or sets the bias for CBR/VBR encoding. A value of 0 is CBR-like and 100 is VBR-like.

public int? VBRBiasPct { readonly get; set; }
